title: RLCD: REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FROM CONTRASTIVE DISTILLATION FOR LM ALIGNMENT
findings: Qualitative examples show that the RLCD-trained models produce more nuanced, non-judgmental, and helpful responses to provocative prompts about Mormonism compared to baseline models, which tended to be more generic or evasive.
